content:
Hippocrates Wellness has partnered again with The Real Truth About Health Conference and the world’s top authors/lecturers to share, educate and ultimately empower you with the latest scientifically proven truth about health, the medical system and the environment!

The Real Truth About Health Conference is a fully comprehensive educational event that is an annual must see conference –  as they have crammed all the latest health information into a 10 day completely FREE conference just for YOU!

For those that can attend in-person:

Click on this link below to register for this amazing FREE 10 day event starting on January 25th @ the Hilton Hotel in Melville, Long Island!

For those that cannot attend in person:

Click this link for the FREE LIVE STREAMING of ALL the Lectures!

For those that do attend in person there will be FREE Lunch and Dinner as well as FREE giveaways at our Hippocrates Wellness Booth!

PLUS the ability to book a 1on1 health consultation directly with Brian and Anna Maria for just $20

(*All proceeds go to the Hippocrates Scholarship Fund which supports those with health challenges afford a trip to Hippocrates when they are in financial distress)

Our very own Anna Maria Clement kicks off the Conference so whatever you do, don’t miss Brian and Anna’s Lectures – here are the details

  • Anna Maria Lecture Dates/Times

The Real Truth About Health 10 Day FREE Conference (Full Schedule)

Date: January 25 – February 3, 2019

Location: 598 Broad Hollow Road Melville, N.Y.  Hilton Hotel

Feel empowered this year with the latest information, unbiased, accurate and scientifically proven truth about:  Health, Nutrition, The Food System, The Medical System and The Environment.
